mowas2.op.pipeline.desc: PMX to GEM2: fit, pose, freeze, bind, and auto-split or decimate before PLY export
mowas2.prop.pmx.desc: MMD/PMX model to transfer, for example model_better2.pmx
mowas2.prop.mdl.desc: Original skeleton file, such as medicgirl.mdl, human.mdl or 5.mdl
mowas2.prop.output_dir.desc: Parent directory; export creates an <Entity Name> subfolder containing all model files and textures
mowas2.prop.ground_z.desc: Ground height used to align the model feet (default -0.07)
mowas2.prop.protect_face.desc: Keep the face and facial details fixed during decimation to avoid ugly triangles
mowas2.prop.protect_tight.desc: Keep close-fitting clothing fixed during decimation to prevent it from penetrating the skin
mowas2.prop.enable_decimate.desc: Run protected COLLAPSE decimation when automatic splitting is unavailable; disable to keep geometry unchanged
mowas2.prop.auto_split_over_limit.desc: GOH/MOWAS2/CUSTOM: losslessly partition finalized triangles whenever exact records exceed the configured per-PLY limit; every file preserves positions, weights, loop normals and UVs and is referenced directly by the existing skin bone; takes priority over decimation
mowas2.prop.split_record_limit.desc: Exact final record limit per PLY (3-65535); keep 65535 for automatic hard-limit handling or lower it to intentionally create more parts
mowas2.op.import_pmx.label: 1. Import PMX Model

mowas2.op.build_target.label: 2. Build GEM2 Target Skeleton
mowas2.op.build_target.desc: Build the 58-bone target skeleton from an original .mdl
mowas2.op.align.label: 3. Align Head/Body/Legs
mowas2.op.align.desc: Align the model to the original skeleton on the ground with lowered arms for preview
mowas2.op.full_pipeline.label: 4. Export Full Pipeline
mowas2.op.full_pipeline.desc: Align, bind, transfer weights, index final records, auto-split or decimate as needed, and export ply/mdl/def/mtl/textures

mowas2.human_rest.converted_export.desc: Use the destination MDL and destination SKIN order

ply.export.unique_vertex_limit: {vertices} unique output vertices exceed the native GEM2 u16 limit of 65535. Reduce the mesh further or split it into multiple VolumeViews.
mowas2.prop.skin_name.desc: GOH resource/entity name: writes <name>/<name>.def, .mdl and .ply (for example agf_xxx)
mowas2.prop.goh_hand_split.desc: On = hand weights follow GFA table split into palm1/palm2/palm3 (matches GOH stock skins, hand IK/FK aligns; recommended). Off = MOWAS2-style palm1 single bone (legacy exports).
anm.extract_goh.label: Extract GOH Animations (.anm)
anm.extract_goh.desc: Extract .anm animations from GOH properties.pak by keyword (human anims live under properties/animation/human/ in the pak)
anm.extract_goh.keyword.desc: Filter animation names (e.g. idle/walk/fire/stand); empty = all
anm.extract_goh.limit.desc: Avoid extracting too many at once (1599 in pak)
mowas2.prop.remember_settings.desc: Restore the last panel values and output folder in new or reopened scenes
mowas2.prop.texture_format.desc: Choose the dependency-free TGA workflow or externally compressed DDS
mowas2.prop.texture_format.tga.desc: 32-bit TGA with no external dependency; preserves the established workflow
mowas2.prop.texture_format.dds.desc: BC1/BC1a/BC3 with mipmaps for interoperability with other GOH mods
mowas2.prop.nvtt_path.desc: Optional nvtt_export.exe or nvcompress.exe path; leave empty for automatic detection
mowas2.prop.toon_shader.desc: Emit GFA ToonShaderConvert-compatible bump/full_specular materials; requires Workshop 3565678181
mowas2.prop.goh_gfa_longarm.desc: Scale source upper-arm/forearm segments to GFA long-arm proportions. Does not replace the selected target skeleton; pick short-arm, long-arm, or any other .mdl yourself
mowas2.prop.goh_enlarge_head.desc: Scale the head from the source Head bone without changing the target rest skeleton
mowas2.prop.goh_head_scale.desc: Head scale factor; enabled by Enlarge Head
mowas2.prop.goh_head_neck_follow.desc: Radial follow of Neck weights and same-mesh neck accessories; drag after alignment for live preview, 0 restores the baseline and 1 fully follows head scale
mowas2.prop.goh_alpha_test: Use Alpha Test for Transparent Materials
mowas2.prop.goh_alpha_test.desc: Use GOH-style alpharef 127 + blend test for general transparency; Eyes+/eyeblend preserves soft alpha and constant alpha=0 layers are omitted
mowas2.prop.goh_fix_pupil_depth.desc: Push pupils out only for real penetration or near-coplanarity; material constant-alpha and texture-blend faults are handled separately by the exporter
mowas2.prop.goh_pupil_clearance.desc: Minimum gap along both the eye normal and forward view; reversible live preview after alignment, range 0–0.1, default 0.006
mowas2.prop.goh_ik_updown_scale.desc: Scale only the lateral coordinates finally mapped to ik_updown; rest bones stay fixed with reversible live preview
mowas2.prop.goh_ik_updown_multiplier.des: 1.0 preserves the original curve; values above 1 slightly widen the ik_updown region
mowas2.prop.goh_foot1_spacing.desc: Move the hip silhouette inward/outward. Equal values on hip/thigh/calf stay continuous with no junction jump. 1.0 = unchanged
mowas2.prop.goh_thigh_width.desc: Outward move of the thigh segment. Shares a partition-of-unity blend with hip and calf
mowas2.prop.goh_calf_width.desc: Outward move of the calf segment, fading at the ankle. Continuous with thigh outward
mowas2.prop.goh_hip_thickness.desc: Radial girth around the hip, independent of outward move. Equal thickness values stay continuous
mowas2.prop.goh_thigh_thickness.desc: Radial girth around the thigh bone. Blends smoothly into hip and calf thickness
mowas2.prop.goh_calf_thickness.desc: Radial girth around the calf bone, fading at the ankle
mowas2.prop.goh_arm_span_scale.desc: 1.0 keeps the current result; values below 1 rigidly translate both complete arms toward the body center without shortening arms, hands, or target rest bones
mowas2.prop.goh_arm_thickness.desc: 1.0 keeps the original thickness; values above 1 thicken the upper arm and forearm around the bone axis, values below 1 thin them. Palms and rest bones stay put. Type a number; this is not a slider
mowas2.prop.goh_shoulder_inset.desc: Values below 1 pull the clavicle/shoulder-band vertices toward the body centerline along the lateral axis (anime narrow shoulder). Frozen geometry only: target rest bones and animation pivots are never edited. 1.0 disables
mowas2.prop.goh_shoulder_mode.desc: Default is plan C (SKELETON): build a narrow-shoulder alignment target from the source bone span and bind back to the original animation rest. GEOMETRY is plan B mesh inset; OFF leaves shoulders unchanged
mowas2.prop.goh_shoulder_mode.geometry.d: Pull clavicle/shoulder-band vertices inward after freezing; rest bones and animation pivots untouched
mowas2.prop.goh_shoulder_mode.skeleton.d: Build a narrow-shoulder target from the measured source bone span; bind back to the original skeleton so animation rest is unchanged
mowas2.prop.goh_shoulder_narrow_ratio.de: User multiplier on the narrower default. Four-stage PMX base is now 0.85; KK default is 0.96. Lower is narrower, higher is wider. Type a number
mowas2.prop.goh_shoulder_attach.desc: How the narrow-shoulder hand chain attaches under plan C
mowas2.prop.goh_shoulder_attach.full.des: Translate the whole arm chain inward as one; hand follows (keepfrozen behavior)
mowas2.prop.goh_shoulder_attach.blend.de: Scale shoulder inward + keep forearm/hand at original GOH rest + rotate upper arm collinear, slight stretch allowed, accessories/fingers undistorted in animation
mowas2.prop.goh_foot_scale.desc: Scale feet and footwear around the target ankle while keeping soles on the ground
mowas2.prop.goh_shoulder_scale.desc: Retained only for loading old settings; v133 no longer stretches the central torso by itself
mowas2.prop.goh_torso_ik_merge.desc: Merge part of ik_leftright weight into ik_updown to reduce torso stretching during deep bends
mowas2.prop.goh_iklr_keep.desc: Fraction of ik_leftright weight to retain; 1.0 leaves it unchanged
mowas2.prop.goh_hand_clamp.desc: Clamp hand-chain length ratios to 0.85-1.15 to prevent wrist-to-palm separation
mowas2.prop.goh_wrist_stitch.desc: Restore the real hand_rot1 pivot and smoothly recover wrist geometry compressed by old shoulder scaling
mowas2.prop.goh_finger_curl.desc: Apply the GFA 40-degree inward finger curl to standard MMD sources; disabled by default
